response.claim: Regulated entities must update KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry no later than 7 days after receiving updated information from a customer.
response.final_answer: KYCSYNC2 classifies elapsed time as OVERDUE when it exceeds seven days and otherwise labels it INSLA, then displays the status and stops. It does not perform the required KYC record update in the Central KYC Records Registry. This is a missing required action (D2); the > 7 threshold itself matches the seven-day window.
